digest.component_or_area: reconciler vendor-adapter seam / backend abstraction layer
propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission/ingestion boundaries through port calls.
All 8 vendor modules (acli*, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, etc.) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims or vendor reach-through in core.
Backend selection and transport construction must route through select_backend() registry, eliminating direct provider literals and transport instantiation in core.
The outbound differ must canonicalize fetched snapshots via InboundMapper, build vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper at emission, and compare canonical shapes only.
Zero vendor imports or lazy-key literals in package-root src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py (except inbound_fields.py pending relocation), verified by AST/sweep tests.
Scalar port surface (project, query_project, assert_env_ready, neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) and canonical link/field/absence-probe diffs must complete the vendor-agnostic interface.
